extra.message: Tool uses an unsafe deserialization function (pickle.loads, yaml.load, marshal.loads) without safe loader enforcement. If tool arguments or external data are deserialized this way, an attacker who controls the input can achieve arbitrary code execution by crafting a malicious serialized payload.

noviscent.remediation: Replace pickle/marshal with safe serialization formats (JSON, MessagePack). For YAML, always use yaml.safe_load(). Never deserialize data received from untrusted sources or agent arguments.
noviscent.title: Unsafe Deserialization in Tool

extra.message: MCP server initialized without authentication middleware. This is an advisory heuristic. noviscent.remediation: Add authentication middleware (OAuth2, API key validation, or JWT) before initializing and exposing the MCP server.
